newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore to allow more mobile phone services.
newsitem.headline: Singapore to allow more mobile phone services.

text.p: Singapore said on Friday it would call for tenders for one or two more licences to operate mobile telephone services to challenge the two present operators.
The Telecommunication Authority of Singapore (TAS) said in a statement it would call tenders by October and would announce the results by the middle of 1998.
That would give the successful applicants at least 20 months to build and test their networks for services to begin commercial operation from April 1, 2000.
Singapore Telecommunications Ltd lost its monopoly of all telephone services on April 1 this year when MobileOne began cellular phone services.
MobileOne is a consortium formed by Keppel Telecom, Singapore Press Holdings, Cable & Wireless and HongKong Telecommunications.
